g.text: 03 | Where LoRA helps - and where it costs

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: DINOv3 LoRA minus adapted CNN, every completed source cell; the displayed contrast is one of 62 saved comparisons

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b40

g.text: Intervals are retrospective, conditional on fitted systems, and unadjusted across comparisons. Seed markers show training variation, not a CI.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Native AP has no pixel-bootstrap interval. FPR / recall / review axes show percentage-point changes; saved CSV/JSON preserve raw ratios.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Lower review must be read together with recall. This is a complete ten-cell source contrast, not an interim confirmation-performance conclusion.
